messages.text: Sabalenka survives Noskova battle to keep US Open three-peat bid alive

metadata.summary: Aryna Sabalenka maintained her hopes of a third successive US Open title with a three-set victory over Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova in an absorbing quarter-final - a result that retains her status as world No 1 for at least one more day.
metadata.content: US Open 2026: Aryna Sabalenka edges into semi-finals with three-set win over Linda Noskova in thriller | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content US Open 2026: Aryna Sabalenka edges into semi-finals with three-set win over Linda Noskova in thriller Aryna Sabalenka retains world No 1 spot with battling win - but will lose it on Wednesday if Elena Rybakina reaches semi-finals; Sabalenka is looking to become first woman to win US Open three times in row since Serena Williams between 2012 and 2014; watch tournament live on Sky Sports Tuesday 8 September 2026 20:48, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights from the US Open Open Quarter-final match between Aryna Sabalenka and Linda Noskova Aryna Sabalenka maintained her hopes of a third successive US Open title with a three-set victory over Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova in an absorbing quarter-final - a result that retains her status as world No 1 for at least one more day. The 28-year-old beat Noskova 7-6 (7-1) 3-6 7-6 (10-7), coming through two tie-breaks - and a 4-2 deficit in the final set - as she sealed victory with a second-serve ace to set up a meeting with the winner of Tuesday night's all-American clash between Jessica Pegula and Emma Navarro in the semi-finals.
